description: [BR-CRM-005] Maps a spoken caller category to a Customer Group (and the price list a new caller of that category is quoted from).

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Lower-case value the agent sends as caller_type, e.g. individual, retailer, wholesale, distributor.

fields.label: Price List
fields.description: Price list a quote for a new caller in this category uses. Blank = the agent does not quote; the team calls back.

fields.label: Default For Category
fields.description: The row a new caller of this category is mapped to. A category with no default row is flagged for the team on the callback task.

name: Sarvam Caller Category
